column1: 1. Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 14 and 15, income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an
entertainer such as a theatre, motion picture, radio or television artiste or a musician, or as a sportsperson, from his
personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, income derived from activities referred to in paragraph 1

the Contracting State in which the activities are exercised, if the visit to that Contracting State is wholly or substantially
